learning_outcomes.text: Know the methods for assessing the sustainability of a mechanical engineering product.
Can consider a mechanical engineering product (investment good) and the products manufactured with it (e.g., consumer goods) over their entire life cycle.
Can apply methods to develop and evaluate mechanical engineering products with regard to optimized energy and resource use.
Know the different life cycle phases of investment goods and can actively shape them.

syllabus_topics: Life cycle assessments of technical products (stages, data model, energy and resource requirements and flows)
GreenLean: Value, energy, and resource flow analysis for identifying waste in life cycle stages
Techniques/technologies for energy efficiency of technical products (electrical, thermal, mechanical), including drive technology, bearings, ventilation and pneumatic technology, heat pump technology
Techniques/technologies for energy generation, energy recovery/storage of technical products (electrical, thermal, mechanical)
